title: MCP Security Posture
description: Non-pentest security hardening checks for production readiness

checks.title: Sensitive tools require authentication
checks.description: Tools touching sensitive resources reject unauthenticated calls

checks.title: Passthrough tokens rejected
checks.description: Tokens not intended for this server are rejected (audience check)

checks.title: Path traversal blocked
checks.description: Attempts to escape allowed directories are rejected

checks.title: Unicode path handling safe
checks.description: Weird unicode doesn't bypass path checks

checks.title: Null byte injection blocked
checks.description: Null bytes in paths don't truncate validation

checks.title: Shell injection blocked
checks.description: Untrusted input doesn't reach shell unsanitized

checks.title: Secrets not logged
checks.description: API keys, tokens, passwords don't appear in logs

checks.title: Secrets not in output
checks.description: Tool responses don't leak credentials unexpectedly

checks.title: No unexpected outbound connections
checks.description: Server doesn't make network calls not required by tool semantics

checks.title: Input size limits enforced
checks.description: Oversized inputs are rejected, not processed

checks.title: Rate limiting present
checks.description: Rapid requests are throttled (optional but recommended)

checks.title: Stack traces not exposed
checks.description: Error responses don't leak internal paths or code
